name: Big Blind UBC 2019

venue.name: [UBC](https://www.ubc.ca/)
venue.details: Banquet Room 2504 (see Locations tab for more details)

information: This competition is right after the multi-venue competition [FMC Americas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCAmericas2019) and only has blindfolded events. You must register for each competition separately. Spectators are welcome, but must be absolutely silent to allow competitors to concentrate.
